summary.text: Isaiah Harris is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican DJ Perry.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he works full-time at a grocery store and is a member of UFCW Local 2.

paragraphs.text: Isaiah Harris graduated from Pittsburg High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Pittsburg State University in 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong resident of the district, was raised by a single mother, and helps support his wife's in-home daycare.
Harris said in the survey that he supports expanding KanCare, raising the minimum wage to $15 an hour, protecting Social Security, and making child care more affordable.
